 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Sinha

Oral Order
2 07-05-2025

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State along with learned counsel for the O.P. No.2.
2.

The petitioner seeks bail in anticipation of his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376, 498(A), 323 of the Indian Penal Code, 8 of POCSO Act and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. The learned counsel for the parties jointly submits that one time settlement has been reached at between the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 and hence he prays that the matter be referred for mediation.
4. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, the matter is referred to the Mediation Center, Patna High Court.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.27736 of 2025(2) dt.07-05-2025 5.

The petitioner and the O.P. No.2 along with the respective learned counsels shall remain physically present before the Mediation Center of the Patna High Court on 18.06.2025, so that the matter is referred to learned mediator for resolving the dispute amicably.
